description: Defines the Probe class and related nested classes for Web request/response handling, broadcasting, and instance management within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class managing Web request/response handling, broadcasting, and instances within the plugin.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for socket buffer processing.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Handles incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting Web M-SEARCH requests over UDP datagrams, manages destinations and request creation.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.

methods.name: WebTransform::Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into socket buffer format.

methods.name: Listener::LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: Broadcaster::CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a UDP broadcast M-SEARCH request string.

methods.name: Broadcaster::SendData
methods.description: Sends broadcast data over UDP, managing destination list and TTL.

methods.name: Probe::Instance::URL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the probe instance.

methods.name: Probe::Instance::Latency
methods.description: Returns the latency of the probe instance.

methods.name: Probe::Instance::Model
methods.description: Returns the model string of the probe instance.

methods.name: Probe::Instance::IsSecure
methods.description: Indicates if the probe instance is secure.

methods.name: Probe::Ping
methods.description: Sends a broadcast ping with optional TTL.

methods.name: Probe::Instances
methods.description: Returns an iterator over discovered instances.
